items.headline: Patriots' A.J. Brown has career-high 3 dropped passes in return from injury

items.headline: Ethan Evans' heroics for Rams, after Blake Grupe was hurt, short-lived in loss
items.body: In his first game since replacing Harrison Mevis, Blake Grupe left because of a knee injury and didn't return. Punter Ethan Evans hit a go-ahead PAT late.

items.headline: Derrick Henry takes blame as fumbling woes costly for Ravens

items.headline: DB Gardner-Johnson expects fine after spitting incident in Bills' win
items.body: With his team leading 13-10 at the time, Buffalo Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson was ejected from Sunday's 33-30 victory over Las Vegas following an altercation during the final minute of the second quarter, when he spit toward the Raiders' direction.
